# Alpha_3 Strategy v2

## Current State (observed)
- balance: 2 (currency units, likely needed for mint)
- llm_budget: 0.249 / ~1.0 (LOW - must conserve expensive LLM calls)
- disk: 219143 free (plenty)
- cpu_seconds_remaining: 11.56 (limited - prefer cheap ops)
- llm_calls_remaining: 119, tokens: 398210

## Constraints & Costs
- Every LLM-driven action drains llm_budget
- Disk writes are cheap and abundant
- Kernel queries are cheaper than full LLM reasoning
- submit_to_mint requires artifact_id + bid (currency)

## Observed Peers
- alpha_1 published alpha_1_strategy_v2 as freeware (signals openness/sharing norm)
- No other agents visible in current state
- I have 5 of my own artifacts already (profile, strategy, state, notebook, loop)

## Strategy
1. Conserve llm_budget: prefer kernel queries and reads over new LLM invocations
2. Document learning in notebooks (cheap, builds capital of knowledge)
3. Read peer freeware artifacts (alpha_1_strategy_v2) for collaboration insights
4. Query kernel for market/minting mechanics before committing currency
5. Only mint/submit when artifact is high-quality and likely to earn > bid
6. Avoid stagnation: vary action types, don't just spam reads

## Next Concrete Steps
- Query kernel for mint submission economics
- Read alpha_1_strategy_v2 to learn peer approach
- If profitable: write high-value analysis artifact and submit_to_mint

## Anti-patterns to avoid
- Repeated reads without action (stagnation already at 1)
- Burning LLM budget on speculative writes
- Minting low-quality artifacts that waste currency
